title: Free Portfolio Review
shortText: Upload your CAS and get a clear picture of your existing mutual funds.
whatItIs: Many investors hold schemes across several AMCs and folios without a clear view of the overall picture. Share your Consolidated Account Statement (CAS) and our team will walk you through your existing holdings - asset mix, overlap, costs and how the schemes' risk levels compare with your profile. We explain; the decisions remain yours.
whoItSuits: Anyone with existing mutual fund investments who wants a consolidated, easy-to-understand view of their portfolio.
howItWorks: Download your CAS from CAMS, KFintech or NSDL / CDSL
Upload the PDF on this page and verify your mobile with an OTP
Your relationship manager reviews it and calls you within two working days
We walk you through the observations - no obligation

faqs.question: Is my CAS safe with you?
faqs.answer: The file is uploaded over a secure connection, stored in our database with access restricted to authorised staff, and every download is logged.

faqs.question: Do I have to switch my investments?
faqs.answer: No. The review is free and without obligation.
